name: EDTSMockURLKit
summary: A mock networking library for iOS with floating button UI.
description:
EDTSMockURLKit intercepts API calls and returns mock responses from a
configurable backend server. It provides a draggable floating button UI for
toggling mock mode at runtime. Activate only from builds that need it —
the library is inert if setup() is never called.
